about: Thresholds for the revenue change explainer. scripts/revenue_split.py reads this file and its CLI defaults come from it. Each key is explained under notes.

notes.completed_statuses: Status values that count as a completed order when --status isn't given (compared without case). Pass --status with the project's own value when it differs.
notes.per_day_tolerance: When the periods differ in length and revenue per day changed by less than this share (0.03 = 3%), the change in totals is put down to the extra days, not a real change.
notes.max_breakdowns: Breakdowns (--breakdown) to run before asking the user for more. The script reads at most this many and says when more were given.
notes.ratio_check_tolerance: The buyers, orders-per-buyer and AOV ratios multiplied back must match the revenue ratio within this relative difference. With raw counts they match exactly; a bigger gap means an input is wrong.
notes.add_up_tolerance: Money that may be left over (in the project's currency) when segment changes or money parts are added up and compared with the total change. Bigger gaps are reported.
